description: This file defines a PHPStan extension class 'PregMatchParameterOutTypeExtension' that provides type inference for certain static methods of the 'Preg' class related to regex matching.

classes.name: PregMatchParameterOutTypeExtension
classes.description: A final class implementing type inference extension for specific static regex match methods in the 'Preg' class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the regex shape matcher dependency.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if a static method is supported based on the method's declaring class, name, and parameter name.

methods.name: getParameterOutTypeFromStaticMethodCall
methods.description: Infers the output type of a static method call based on regex pattern and flags arguments, using the regex shape matcher.
